style: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE woodland game asset. The input image is the STYLE REFERENCE: match its delicate airy watercolor storybook illustration, fine warm brown pencil outlines, simplified graceful forms, light fresh green leaves, pale pink flowers, warm cream/gold accents, subtle magical gold specks. Avoid dense realistic gouache texture, photorealism, cartoon giant eyes, thick outlines, dark shadows. Soft and slightly mysterious, gentle, not flashy. Entire isolated object fully visible with margin. Transparent PNG background requested; no white rectangle or scene unless subject specifically requests a backdrop. No text. Subject:

Growth stage 1: a tiny newly sprouted seedling, two large green leaves, a short delicate stem with one tiny golden glint, just a few specks of magic. No branches yet.
Growth stage 2: a small young sapling, slender golden brown stem, two forked twigs, six large green leaves, faint golden vine motif beginning on trunk, a few floating tiny gold lights.
Growth stage 3: a young magical tree, slim winding trunk with three branches, ten large green leaves and a few unopened pink flower buds, gentle gold vine motifs and a few gold stars.

Growth stage 4: a medium magical tree, graceful branching trunk with clear gold spiral and leaf motifs, many large individual green leaves and just a few open pink flowers, a soft gold aura and floating sparks. Less developed than the reference.

Growth stage 5, fully grown symbol tree. Recreate the reference tree's distinctive graceful winding trunk, golden spiral and leaf markings, sparse open airy branching silhouette with large individual green leaves and pink blossoms, floating gold star glints and curls, a soft ethereal golden aura. Keep the original identity very closely, full tree including tiny roots and little ground patch. NOT a bushy oak canopy.

Wide 16:9 woodland clearing backdrop for the game. A large EMPTY softly painted pale sage meadow in central 70 percent for game objects. Frame only edges with delicate trees, large individual green leaves, tiny pink blossoms, warm gold glints. Dreamy luminous pastel watercolor like reference, airy simple children's illustration with abundant breathing room, no central tree or central focal object. Background landscape may be opaque, no interface, no words.
